beats.objective: Take soup to {friend.first} before the night shift
Decide whose door you reach first
Bring the last ration box to {keeper.first}
Bring the last ration box to {friend.first}

first_night.speaker: patron
first_night.text: {patron.first} {patron.family} slides a warm bag across the counter of {patron.place}. "[Rent's due Monday, courier|You look like you need the work]. Orders come in every hour. Find the door, keep it hot, don't feed the gangs."

keeper_door.speaker: keeper
keeper_door.text: The door opens a crack. {keeper.first} {keeper.family}, old and sharp-eyed, counts the coins twice. "You're new. The last one never came this deep." On the shelf behind them sits a dented tin, polished like a relic.

friend_door.speaker: friend
friend_door.text: {friend.first} {friend.family} takes the soup with both hands. "[Twelve hours on the ward|Another double shift] and you're the first face that didn't want something from me. Come by again, will you?"

rival.speaker: rival
rival.text: A courier in a patched jacket cuts in front of you at the counter and grabs your next order. "{rival.first}. Remember it — this stretch was mine before you showed up."

blight.speaker: patron
blight.text: {patron.first} pins a new price list over the old one. "The blight's in the farm layers. {monopolist.name} says supply is short, so everything costs three times as much. Funny how their warehouses never run dry."

rationing.speaker: patron
rationing.text: "One ration box left tonight," {patron.first} says. "{keeper.first} hasn't eaten since yesterday. {friend.first}'s ward lost its kitchen. Your call, courier."

ration_keeper.speaker: keeper
ration_keeper.text: {keeper.first} holds the box like it might vanish. "My great-aunt used to say the city was built on a lie about how little there is." The tin is on the table now.

ration_friend.speaker: friend
ration_friend.text: {friend.first} shares the box out among the night staff before taking a bite. "Someone's sitting on food while people faint in the corridors. I'll remember who brought this."

hijack.speaker: disruptor
hijack.text: Word runs down the corridors: {disruptor.name} hijacked two couriers on the bridges last night and sold the food at blight prices. They know your face now.

rally.speaker: idealists
rally.text: In the stairwell, people from {idealists.name} press leaflets into every hand: OPEN THE WAREHOUSES. "Couriers go everywhere," one says. "Carry a few for us?"

keeper_call.speaker: keeper
keeper_call.text: A message on the courier board, in shaky capitals: COME TOMORROW. THERE IS SOMETHING I MUST GIVE YOU BEFORE THEY DO. — {keeper.first} {keeper.family}
